title: Comment on a PDF
description: Highlight, add notes and callouts, and review all comments in one list.

steps.title: Highlight
steps.text: Select some text on the page, then press H to highlight it. The Highlight tool here draws a coloured box over an area instead.

steps.title: Add a sticky note
steps.text: Click the Sticky note tool (or press N), then click the page where the note should sit and type your comment.

steps.title: Add a callout
steps.text: Click the Callout comment tool (or press C). Drag a box on the page, then type your text in it. The callout points at the spot you started from.

steps.title: Markup with a comment
steps.text: Click the Markup + comment tool (or press M). Drag a dotted shape around the item you mean, then type your comment beside it.

steps.title: Review all comments
steps.text: Open the Comments tab in the sidebar to see every comment in the file. Click one to go to it, or use Reply to answer it.

steps.title: Set your author name
steps.text: Open the Edit menu and choose Author name… so your comments show who wrote them.
